column1: The official DAB container image repository is {{c1::mcr.microsoft.com/azure-databases/data-api-builder}}.
column2:
The repository identifies the official image. Add an explicit version tag to choose the engine build rather than relying on an implicit tag that can change.
Review source

column1: In a DAB Linux Dockerfile, {{c1::COPY dab-config.json /App/dab-config.json}} packages the API configuration.
column2:
This copies the configuration to the path used by the image. Anyone with access to the image can inspect the file, so keep credentials in runtime settings instead.
Review source

column1: For DAB listening on container port 5000, set Container Apps ingress with {{c1::--target-port 5000}}.
column2:
Ingress sends requests to this port inside the container. A mismatch prevents requests from reaching DAB even if the container starts and listens on another port.
Review source

column1: In az containerapp create, expose the DAB app through public ingress with {{c1::--ingress external}}.
column2:
External ingress lets traffic reach the app from outside its Container Apps environment. It does not determine which callers can read or modify an API entity.
Review source

column1: For an existing Container Apps secret named database-conn, reference its value in --env-vars with {{c1::DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING=secretref:database-conn}}.
column2:
The value after secretref names a Container Apps secret, not the credential itself. The app supplies that secret to the process as DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING at runtime.
Review source

column1: An App Service Key Vault reference uses {{c1::@Microsoft.KeyVault}}(SecretUri=secret-uri) as an app setting value.
column2:
App Service resolves the secret URI using its configured identity. The app setting contains a reference, but the app receives the resolved value if that identity can read it.
Review source

column1: For Azure SQL system-assigned managed identity authentication, include {{c1::Authentication=Active Directory Managed Identity;}} in DAB's connection string.
column2:
This connection string option tells the SQL client to request a token from the host's managed identity. For a system-assigned identity, omit User ID and Password.
Review source

column1: The GitHub Action for deploying a DAB image to Container Apps is {{c1::azure/container-apps-deploy-action}}.
column2:
The action can deploy an existing image or build one from supplied source. If a separate pipeline job tested the image, deploy that artifact rather than building it again.
Review source

column1: Pass an already pushed DAB image to azure/container-apps-deploy-action through its {{c1::imageToDeploy}} input.
column2:
Supply the full registry, repository, and tag of the image that already exists. The deployment uses that image rather than invoking a new source build.
Review source

column1: A Container Apps {{c1::Liveness}} probe tests whether the DAB process can respond so Azure can decide whether to restart it.
column2:
A liveness failure can cause the platform to restart the container. Choose a signal that reflects whether the process can respond, not every temporary problem with a dependency.
Review source

column1: A Container Apps {{c1::Readiness}} probe tests whether a DAB replica is ready to receive traffic.
column2:
A replica that fails readiness must not receive normal traffic. A database-aware check can keep it out of rotation until SQL becomes available again.
Review source

column1: In DAB, {{c1::/health}} reports configured data-source and entity checks rather than basic service information.
column2:
The health report tests configured data sources and eligible entities. A probe must be allowed to read it. Entity checks do not invoke stored procedures, which can have side effects.
Review source

column1: When a Dockerfile declares ARG ENVIRONMENT, select production during docker build with {{c1::--build-arg ENVIRONMENT=production}}.
column2:
The build argument supplies a value when Docker builds the image. It selects a configuration only if the Dockerfile uses it. Do not pass runtime credentials through a build argument.
Review source
